scope: Invoice tax persistence and Tier-1 infrastructure selection
assertions: Two persisted invoice charges retain the correct service identities, net amounts (1000 and 500 cents), and tax amounts (89 and 40 cents).
Invoice subtotal, tax and total are exactly 1500, 129 and 1629 cents.
Existing suite also verifies recalculation, taxable/exempt and positive/negative line behavior.

environment.cleanup: Both containers stopped and automatically removed after test completion.

limitations: Existing integration harness substitutes authentication and transaction wrappers; this is real database invoice persistence, not a browser/authentication test.
The multi-region case supplies billing charges, so recurring charge generation is outside its scope.
Tier-1 selection is configured locally; publication and effective required GitHub protections remain unverified for this candidate.
